signals.text: 1 new PM role posted this week

bullets: Define and own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Protection Programs, connecting customer value, risk reduction, and sustainable business performance.
Build a deep understanding of homeowners, guests, internal teams, and insurance or protection partners; identify where protection addresses meaningful needs across the reservation…
Develop a portfolio strategy across offerings such as damage protection, travel insurance, and chargeback insurance, including where to invest, expand, refine, or retire programs.
Own the commercial model for programs in partnership with Commercial, Finance, and external partners. Evaluate pricing, conversion, coverage, partner economics, claims costs, and…
Identify and validate growth opportunities, including customer segments, distribution moments, packaging, pricing, and partner capabilities; translate them into clear business…
Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Pro, balancing customer needs, business opportunity, and platform investment.
Build a deep understanding of portfolio operators and HOAs: how they assess providers, bring properties and teams onto a platform, manage their operations, and decide whether to…
Improve the end-to-end experience—from evaluating and adopting Pro through onboarding, ongoing portfolio management, and renewal or expansion.
Identify shared needs across customer types and shape modular, configurable product capabilities that avoid one-off development for each use case.
Make clear product choices across a large, ambiguous surface area, sequencing work and explaining tradeoffs to senior stakeholders and delivery teams.
Own the product roadmap from signed agreement to a live, bookable listing, with activation rate, time to live and 180-day retained activations as the measures of success
Find where owners stall — property setup, photo scheduling, permits, rates, multi-property onboarding — and decide what to fix first and how
